additionalProperties.description: Every property is an array, even holding one value. This is the guarantee the whole shape rests on.

description: A number that names the resource, and the scheme it belongs to.

@type.$comment: An array when a node has several types, a string when it has one. @type is a keyword, so no @container reaches it.

title: Identifier

^@.description: A JSON-LD keyword is not a property, so the array rule does not reach it. @context is the reason: it is a vocabulary rather than data.

not.description: a blank node must not carry an @id
